conclusions: Actual open path now waits for the visible native Operator combobox, direct label span, enabled state and exact current canonical value, with an explicit 30000ms timeout; the original readiness assertion is unchanged.
Acknowledged native selection reuses the same direct-span readiness predicate, replacing whole-label text matching that included option labels.
Native capture/current-selection assertions, source/authority/dispatch/request/cleanup guards and every other shared module are unchanged.
limits: Offline regression executes the actual extracted open/select bodies against real released SelectChip SSR markup and jsdom with synthetic timing; this is not live browser or staging acceptance.
Wrong-value and permanently disabled controls still refuse. No reviewer test, network, auth, SQL, browser or job execution occurred.
Parent635 canonical-v2 cannot consume a v4-pinned release input via its v3 sibling hash check; a new import-only parent version must bind the coherent v4 set.
